axes.name: closed_state_update
axes.rationale: The closed-window path applies the same selected-state transition but bypasses redraw.

axes.name: changed_type_dispatch
axes.rationale: Type 0x11 and 5 use DrawObject, type 13 draws the state-selected bitmap, and default types invert the object rectangle; test exact range-chain versus switch lowering.

switch (type) { case 0x11: case 5: win_DrawObject(object); break; case 0x0d: GSetAttrib(_foreColor, _backColor, monoPat & 0x7f); win_DrawBitMapAtObj(object, object->bitmap[(object->state & 4) ? 1 : 0]); break; default: GRectInv(object); break; }
